_comment: WRITTEN BY THE PORTAL, NOT BY HAND. The Create Website Post card in the admin panel (WebsitePosts.gs) rebuilds this file from the Website_Posts sheet on every publish, and that commit is what triggers the deploy. The sheet is the source of truth; this is a copy. Editing it here works until the next publish overwrites it. The sample below is here so the design can be seen before the first real post — delete it once there is one.

posts.title: A new website for the school
posts.summary: The school website has been rebuilt. News and announcements will now be posted here directly by the office.
posts.body_md:
The school website has been rebuilt from scratch.

## What is new

The site is now faster, works properly on a phone, and can be updated by the office directly — announcements no longer need anyone technical to publish them.

- News and notices are posted from the school's own admin panel
- Every post gets its own page, so a link shared on WhatsApp shows the headline and picture
- Results stay where they are, on the [school portal](https://portal.baptisthss.in/)

## What is coming

The About, Academics and Admissions pages still need the school's own words, and the prospectus and forms will be added to the Downloads page.

> This is a sample post. It can be deleted once there is real news to publish.
